entities.summary: George Graham Vest was an American politician. Born in Frankfort, Kentucky, he was known for his skills in oration and debate. Vest, a lawyer as well as a politician, served as a Missouri state representative, a Confederate congressman during the Civil War, and finally a U.S. senator.
